scenes.title: The festival preparations
scenes.summary: C02 prepares the phone for amplification while C01 moves the money toward L10. Their exchange establishes protection and a shared commitment.
scenes.purpose: Prepare the public exposure and turn a solitary protective gesture into partnership.
